about: GamID Truth: the authoritative current PRODUCT STATE and APPROVED PRODUCT CONTRACTS of GamID. Not an issue tracker: never add bugs, suspected problems, Monitor findings, test results or secrets. Rules: AGENTS.md.

statuses.ACCEPTED: Implemented on TESTING and formally accepted by Mazen. Preserve unless he authorizes a change.
statuses.PENDING_ACCEPTANCE: Implemented on TESTING; formal acceptance not (yet) given.
statuses.DEPRECATED: Removed or superseded; kept for reference.

capabilities.name: Canonical Cloudflare TESTING frontend and same-origin authentication

contracts.rule: Cloudflare is the canonical TESTING frontend. Account, Play Together and Wall Editor share the existing same-origin authenticated session; no GitHub Pages session transfer is required. TESTING Auth and Discord/Steam connection returns use Cloudflare Account. Cloudflare is the sole active TESTING frontend; legacy GitHub Pages is retired.

Sign-in return intent is a single-use tab-local fixed path for Play Together or Wall Editor, valid for at most five minutes; authenticated Account consumes it. Recovery remains in Account; arbitrary origins and destinations are not accepted.

capabilities.name: Intro / Transition Engine
Account + SOLO identity
YOUR GAMID identity editor

contracts.rule: Owner editor sections expand independently. Editable profile and visibility drafts persist only through their own Save Changes action; saving one section preserves other drafts. Existing relationship, lookup, navigation and publishing actions retain their explicit workflow boundaries.

Profile transient feedback receives five seconds of actual visibility, reset by each new message. Progress and actionable/field validation errors remain persistent. Replaced feedback controllers are disposed; owner lifecycle cleanup and stale-save guards prevent former-owner feedback from affecting the current editor.

capabilities.name: Gaming Roles + Education & Work
Intro identity (owner Intro video upload, processing, Full Preview)

contracts.rule: The user-facing Intro maximum remains 30 seconds. Source metadata and processing/activation permit an inclusive technical tolerance up to 31.0 seconds; values over 31.0 seconds are rejected. The existing 0.5-second minimum remains.

New Intro sources produce opaque VP9/WebM CRF 40 playback derivatives, downscaled only within a 1920-pixel long edge and 1080-pixel short edge, preserving display aspect/orientation, frame rate and timing; existing Opus audio behavior, derivative 15 MiB ceiling and source-retention policy remain. Existing READY derivatives are unchanged.

capabilities.name: F5 native Intro delivery

contracts.rule: Saved READY Intro derivatives use native media delivery with memory-only signed leases of at most 120 seconds. Public playback and Replay revalidate current PUBLIC identity and active READY path; owner Preview resolves lazily under the current authenticated owner. Local upload Blob previews and accepted Intro Engine/F2 semantics remain. Lifecycle termination detaches all main/Split media sources; downloaded or browser-cached bytes are not remotely revocable.
